blurb: Guests can enjoy a variety of craft beers brewed on site, including gluten-reduced options, as well as food from The Kitchen with seasonal menus. The taproom offers indoor seating, picnic tables outside, and a view of the brewery's copper tanks. Private event spaces are available for small to large gatherings with amenities like private bartenders, stages, and projectors.
extraNote: Open on Christmas Eve, New Years Eve, New Years Day, MLK Day, President's Day, Easter, Memorial Day and Labor Day · Closed Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day unless a home Ravens game · Parking available on Ridgely St. and Alluvion St., free street parking except during home Ravens games · Lot O parking is paid during home O's, home Ravens and stadium events · Taproom at 1421 Ridgely St, Baltimore, MD 21230
